rows.source_label: 비키니형 간호 코스튬 — Nurse-themed bikini costume

rows.proposition_ko: 명시된 성인 착용자가 짙은 테두리의 흰 간호사풍 비키니 상의와 별도의 어울리는 하의를 입고, 같은 착용자의 머리에 작은 흰 캡을 쓴다.
relations: top worn by wearer
bottom worn by the same wearer
cap on the same wearer
preconditions: adult status is explicitly declared independently of appearance
the wearer and each selected wearable are independently identified and open to change
observable_gate: top and bottom are distinguishable pieces
dark edging and cap belong to the same wearer
boundary: A costume does not establish occupation, identity or intent.
No exposure level or sexual action is prescribed.

existing_candidate_comparison.comparison: Existing N44 is one white nurse dress with belt and buttons, not a two-piece bikini with a cap.

rows.uncertainty: One optional color-and-trim realization; not an exhaustive definition or an absence proof.

existing_comparison.comparison: Existing N44 is one white nurse dress with belt and buttons, not a two-piece bikini with a cap.

relations: both edges border the same garment opening
preconditions: the garment exists and its construction is open to change
observable_gate: both fabric edges and the opening are visible on the same garment
boundary: A flat garment does not imply a wearer, nudity, age, activity or material.
This is a construction option rather than a bodily or sexual-act instruction.

existing_candidate_comparison.comparison: The existing open-cup bra concerns the chest cup, not a crotch opening.

rows.source_definition_ko: 몸에 앞치마만 걸친 형태를 가리키는 성인 코스튬 표현.
rows.reason: 앞치마만 착용한다는 전체 의복 범위는 단일 시점에서 가려진 면까지 입증하기 어렵고, 원문은 구체적인 가시 범위와 운반 방식을 지정하지 않는다. 확인되지 않은 옷의 부재를 임의의 양성 시각 사실로 만들지 않는다.
rows.existing_candidate_comparison: 기존 앞치마와 its owner 관련 후보는 특정 구조만 기술하며 다른 모든 의복의 부재를 증명하지 않는다.
rows.follow_up: 명시된 성인 요청과 관찰 범위를 먼저 분명히 하고, 관련 정책·기존 의복 후보를 비교한다.
boundary: 앞치마만 착용한다는 전체 의복 범위는 단일 시점에서 가려진 면까지 입증하기 어렵고, 원문은 구체적인 가시 범위와 운반 방식을 지정하지 않는다. 확인되지 않은 옷의 부재를 임의의 양성 시각 사실로 만들지 않는다.

rows.source_definition_ko: 손목·발목 등에 두르는 띠와 버클을 의상 요소로 사용하는 표현.
rows.proposition_en: A separate decorative strap circles one wrist of the same wearer, and its free end passes through a small buckle on that strap.
rows.proposition_ko: 같은 착용자의 한쪽 손목을 별도 장식용 띠가 둘러싸고, 그 띠의 끝이 같은 띠에 달린 작은 버클을 통과한다.
relations: strap circles the wearer’s wrist
buckle belongs to that strap
strap end passes through that buckle
preconditions: the wrist, strap and buckle are independently identified
the existing wearable scope permits the proposed attachment
observable_gate: wrist, strap end and buckle are visible together
boundary: An ornament does not establish confinement, consent or intent.

existing_candidate_comparison.comparison: That existing realization connects a wrist cuff to a chair arm; this proposes a self-contained decorative strap and buckle without a chair connection.

rows.uncertainty: Only one wrist and one buckle are specified; ankle versions remain separate.
rows.en: A separate decorative strap circles one wrist of the same wearer, and its free end passes through a small buckle on that strap.
rows.ko: 같은 착용자의 한쪽 손목을 별도 장식용 띠가 둘러싸고, 그 띠의 끝이 같은 띠에 달린 작은 버클을 통과한다.

existing_comparison.comparison: That existing realization connects a wrist cuff to a chair arm; this proposes a self-contained decorative strap and buckle without a chair connection.

rows.source_definition_ko: 오래된 제복, 낮은 채도, 창백한 얼굴, 흐릿한 윤곽을 강조한 유형.
rows.proposition_en: One fictional figure wears a weathered nurse-style uniform and pale face makeup; muted colors and a softly blurred outer figure edge contrast with the sharper background.
rows.proposition_ko: 한 허구 인물이 낡아 보이는 간호사풍 제복과 창백한 얼굴 분장을 하고 있으며, 절제된 색감과 인물의 부드럽게 흐릿한 외곽이 더 선명한 배경과 대비된다.
relations: uniform and makeup belong to the same figure
the softer figure edge is compared with the sharper background
preconditions: figure and uniform are independently identified
appearance and image treatment are open
observable_gate: uniform state, face treatment, color treatment and the edge/background contrast are observable together
boundary: Blur and pale makeup do not prove supernatural identity, actual age, occupation or death.

existing_candidate_comparison.comparison: That figure is transparent enough to show a wall pattern through the torso; this option uses a soft edge and does not imply transparency.

rows.uncertainty: An authored still-photo ghost-like proxy, not a universal ghost-nurse definition.
rows.en: One fictional figure wears a weathered nurse-style uniform and pale face makeup; muted colors and a softly blurred outer figure edge contrast with the sharper background.
rows.ko: 한 허구 인물이 낡아 보이는 간호사풍 제복과 창백한 얼굴 분장을 하고 있으며, 절제된 색감과 인물의 부드럽게 흐릿한 외곽이 더 선명한 배경과 대비된다.

existing_comparison.comparison: That figure is transparent enough to show a wall pattern through the torso; this option uses a soft edge and does not imply transparency.

rows.source_definition_ko: 오래된 수용시설·정신병원 호러 배경과 결합한 코스튬 표현. 현대 정신건강 간호복의 공식 명칭은 아니다.
rows.reason: ‘어사일럼 너스’는 역사풍 시설 호러와 결합한 코스튬 명칭이며 현대 정신건강 간호복의 공식 명칭이 아니다. 시설의 진단 대상, 역사, 운영 방식이나 폭력성은 복장과 건물만으로 입증할 수 없다.
rows.existing_candidate_comparison: cand_de2b8911fd545abe834682b5f46fb0e9는 정신질환으로부터 구속복·폭력성을 자동 추론하지 말라는 진단이며 해당 전체 장면의 양성 후보는 아니다.
rows.follow_up: 별도 요청이 있으면 허구의 시설 배경과 의복을 독립 소유자로 지정하고 진단·현대 직무와의 구분을 유지한다.
boundary: ‘어사일럼 너스’는 역사풍 시설 호러와 결합한 코스튬 명칭이며 현대 정신건강 간호복의 공식 명칭이 아니다. 시설의 진단 대상, 역사, 운영 방식이나 폭력성은 복장과 건물만으로 입증할 수 없다.
rows.existing_comparison: cand_de2b8911fd545abe834682b5f46fb0e9는 정신질환으로부터 구속복·폭력성을 자동 추론하지 말라는 진단이며 해당 전체 장면의 양성 후보는 아니다.

rows.source_definition_ko: 색이 어둡고 말라붙은 듯한 혈흔 효과.
rows.proposition_en: On one existing costume panel, a dark-red stage stain has matte, cracked-looking edges against the surrounding fabric.
rows.proposition_ko: 기존 코스튬의 한 천 패널에 어두운 붉은 무대용 얼룩이 있고, 얼룩 가장자리는 주변 천과 대비되는 무광의 갈라진 듯한 모습이다.
relations: stain and surrounding fabric belong to the same panel
the edge bounds the stain
preconditions: the existing panel permits a stage-stain appearance
observable_gate: dark stain, boundary and dry-looking surface are visible on the same panel
boundary: Visible appearance does not prove actual blood, drying time, injury or cause.

existing_candidate_comparison.comparison: N40 specifies a dark-red smeared mark with separate dots but does not specify a dry-looking cracked edge.

rows.uncertainty: Cracked-looking matte texture is an authored example of a dried look, not a chemical claim.
rows.en: On one existing costume panel, a dark-red stage stain has matte, cracked-looking edges against the surrounding fabric.
rows.ko: 기존 코스튬의 한 천 패널에 어두운 붉은 무대용 얼룩이 있고, 얼룩 가장자리는 주변 천과 대비되는 무광의 갈라진 듯한 모습이다.

existing_comparison.comparison: N40 specifies a dark-red smeared mark with separate dots but does not specify a dry-looking cracked edge.

rows.source_label: 응고혈·딱지 효과 — Coagulated blood / Scab effect

rows.proposition_en: Raised, clumped dark-red stage makeup sits on one declared practice-model surface, with its edges visibly attached to that same surface.
rows.proposition_ko: 명시된 분장 연습 모형의 한 표면에 도드라져 뭉친 짙은 붉은 무대 분장이 놓이고, 그 가장자리가 같은 표면에 붙어 있는 것이 보인다.
relations: the deposit sits on the model surface
its visible edges attach to the same surface
preconditions: the practice model and makeup layer are independently identified
observable_gate: raised clumps and their attached boundary are visible together
boundary: A stage effect does not prove actual blood, injury, clotting, healing or elapsed time.

existing_candidate_comparison.comparison: The existing theatrical appliance emphasizes its edge and a separate artist; it does not specify a clumped deposit.

rows.en: Raised, clumped dark-red stage makeup sits on one declared practice-model surface, with its edges visibly attached to that same surface.

existing_comparison.comparison: The existing theatrical appliance emphasizes its edge and a separate artist; it does not specify a clumped deposit.

rows.source_definition_ko: 눈 주변에 깊은 그림자를 만들어 움푹한 인상을 주는 분장.
rows.proposition_en: Dark cosmetic contour surrounds both eyes of the same face, with soft outer transitions that create a hollow-looking eye-area effect.
rows.proposition_ko: 같은 얼굴의 양쪽 눈 주위를 짙은 화장 음영이 둘러싸고, 바깥 경계가 부드럽게 이어져 눈가가 움푹해 보이는 분장 효과를 만든다.
relations: cosmetic contour surrounds both eye areas of that same face
preconditions: the face and both eye areas are independently identified
cosmetic changes are allowed
observable_gate: both eye-area contours and their soft outer transitions are visible
boundary: The makeup appearance does not establish physical eye geometry, age, health or cause.
rows.uncertainty: The depth effect is perceptual and cannot be established by a pigment word alone; lighting can affect its readability.
rows.en: Dark cosmetic contour surrounds both eyes of the same face, with soft outer transitions that create a hollow-looking eye-area effect.
rows.ko: 같은 얼굴의 양쪽 눈 주위를 짙은 화장 음영이 둘러싸고, 바깥 경계가 부드럽게 이어져 눈가가 움푹해 보이는 분장 효과를 만든다.

rows.source_definition_ko: 긴 소매와 스트랩이 있는 억제용 의복을 차용한 호러 요소. 간호 제복과는 별개 의상이다.
rows.proposition_en: A display mannequin wears a straitjacket-style garment whose two long sleeves cross over its front; separate straps are visibly attached across the same front panel.
rows.proposition_ko: 전시용 마네킹이 구속복풍 의복을 착용하고, 그 긴 소매 두 개가 앞면에서 교차하며 별도 스트랩들이 같은 앞판에 걸쳐 붙어 있는 것이 보인다.
rows.primary_owner: one display mannequin wearing one declared garment
relations: both sleeves belong to the garment and cross its front
straps attach across the same front panel
preconditions: the mannequin and garment are independently identified
the scene permits this specific garment
observable_gate: both sleeves, their crossing, straps and front-panel attachment remain visible
boundary: This is a displayed garment, distinct from a nurse uniform.
A visual configuration does not prove restraint, diagnosis, consent or function.

rows.uncertainty: The arrangement is one authored costume realization, not a historical or medical specification.
rows.en: A display mannequin wears a straitjacket-style garment whose two long sleeves cross over its front; separate straps are visibly attached across the same front panel.
rows.ko: 전시용 마네킹이 구속복풍 의복을 착용하고, 그 긴 소매 두 개가 앞면에서 교차하며 별도 스트랩들이 같은 앞판에 걸쳐 붙어 있는 것이 보인다.

existing_comparison.comparison: The existing diagnostic warns against inferring a restraint garment from psychiatric context; it does not depict this garment construction.

rows.source_definition_ko: 손바닥을 펴서 공간이나 이동 방향을 안내하는 장면.
rows.proposition_en: One person extends an arm with an open palm and fingers directed along a visible corridor entrance; the hand and entrance remain in the same frame.
rows.proposition_ko: 한 사람이 팔을 뻗어 손바닥을 펴고 손가락을 보이는 복도 입구 방향으로 두며, 손과 입구가 같은 화면 안에 남는다.
relations: the hand remains connected to the same person’s arm
the fingers point along the entrance direction
preconditions: the person and entrance are independently established
the action and setting are open
observable_gate: the hand direction, attached arm and referenced entrance can be seen together
boundary: The gesture does not prove actual guidance, consent, destination or an off-frame participant.

existing_candidate_comparison.comparison: The existing open hand points toward a nearby person in a three-person intervention; it does not establish a directed path or entrance.

rows.uncertainty: The image is a visible directional proxy; a single still cannot verify that anyone followed it.
rows.en: One person extends an arm with an open palm and fingers directed along a visible corridor entrance; the hand and entrance remain in the same frame.
rows.ko: 한 사람이 팔을 뻗어 손바닥을 펴고 손가락을 보이는 복도 입구 방향으로 두며, 손과 입구가 같은 화면 안에 남는다.

existing_comparison.comparison: The existing open hand points toward a nearby person in a three-person intervention; it does not establish a directed path or entrance.

rows.source_definition_ko: 불규칙한 보폭과 몸통 기울기로 좀비·괴물의 움직임을 표현한다.
rows.proposition_en: A single figure balances with one foot planted and the other lifted forward while the torso leans noticeably to one side; the two legs and the planted support remain visible.
rows.proposition_ko: 한 인물이 한 발을 디디고 다른 발을 앞으로 든 채 몸통을 한쪽으로 눈에 띄게 기울이며, 양쪽 다리와 디딘 지지점이 함께 보인다.
relations: the two legs belong to the same figure
one foot contacts the floor while the other remains lifted
the torso inclines to one side
preconditions: the figure and support surface are independently identified
the posture is open to change
observable_gate: both leg states, torso inclination and planted contact are observable together
boundary: This is a single-frame proxy, not evidence of successive unequal strides, actual balance loss or a zombie identity.

existing_candidate_comparison.comparison: The existing staggered-leg candidate describes feet separated in depth; it does not require a lifted foot or a side-leaning torso.

rows.uncertainty: The source’s irregular gait is temporal; this proposal covers only one possible visible moment.
rows.en: A single figure balances with one foot planted and the other lifted forward while the torso leans noticeably to one side; the two legs and the planted support remain visible.
rows.ko: 한 인물이 한 발을 디디고 다른 발을 앞으로 든 채 몸통을 한쪽으로 눈에 띄게 기울이며, 양쪽 다리와 디딘 지지점이 함께 보인다.

existing_comparison.comparison: The existing staggered-leg candidate describes feet separated in depth; it does not require a lifted foot or a side-leaning torso.

rows.source_definition_ko: 카운터, 모니터, 기록물 등으로 업무 맥락을 만든다.
rows.proposition_en: Within one declared nursing-station set, a monitor and a stack of records sit on the same counter, with each object visibly separate.
rows.proposition_ko: 명시된 간호사 스테이션 세트의 같은 카운터 위에 모니터와 기록물 한 묶음이 놓이며, 각 물체가 서로 구별되어 보인다.
relations: monitor sits on the counter
record stack sits on the same counter
the two objects remain distinguishable
preconditions: the set and each object are independently established
their placement is permitted
observable_gate: counter, monitor, records and both supports are visible together
boundary: The set does not establish a real institution, actual clinical work, occupation or patient information.

existing_candidate_comparison.comparison: N49 depicts beds beneath windows in a historical ward; it does not depict a station counter with a monitor and records.

rows.uncertainty: One optional arrangement, not a required layout for every nursing station.
rows.en: Within one declared nursing-station set, a monitor and a stack of records sit on the same counter, with each object visibly separate.
rows.ko: 명시된 간호사 스테이션 세트의 같은 카운터 위에 모니터와 기록물 한 묶음이 놓이며, 각 물체가 서로 구별되어 보인다.

existing_comparison.comparison: N49 depicts beds beneath windows in a historical ward; it does not depict a station counter with a monitor and records.

rows.source_definition_ko: 벗겨진 벽, 녹슨 장비, 먼지, 어둠 등으로 호러 분위기를 만든다.
rows.proposition_en: In one fictional hospital set, paint peels from a wall; a separate dusty trolley has rough rust-colored patches on its metal frame.
rows.proposition_ko: 한 허구의 병원 세트에서 벽의 도료가 벗겨지고, 별도의 먼지 쌓인 기구대 금속 프레임에는 거친 녹빛 자국이 있다.
relations: peeling paint belongs to the wall
dust and rust-colored patches belong to the same trolley
wall and trolley are within the same set
preconditions: the set, wall and trolley are independently identified
their visible states are open to change
observable_gate: wall damage, distinct trolley, dust and frame patches remain separately visible
boundary: A set does not prove actual abandonment, elapsed time, chemical corrosion, injury or cause.

owned_or_related_parts: one neutrally lit white garment area
relations: the red fixture illuminates one region of the garment
the white and red-lit regions belong to the same garment
preconditions: fixture and garment are independently identified
lighting and appearance are open
observable_gate: fixture and both differently lit areas of the same garment are visible
boundary: Color on the fabric does not prove an actual emergency or a red garment material.
